text:
You need someone who can collect and transform raw tennis data, improve its quality, and turn it into clear analytical outputs and visuals that coaches and players can actually use.

I’m Noor Halden, a data scientist with 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning. I’d be excited to support your tennis analytics team with data collection, enrichment, analysis, and building reliable tools for dashboards and visuals. I’m especially comfortable working in Python and using scikit-learn, pandas, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, OpenAI API, XGBoost, and NLP techniques when the problem calls for it.

One project that matches the kind of analytical workflow you’re looking for was a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. I built a classifier in Python and scikit-learn that routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, served through FastAPI, with nightly retraining handled by a Celery worker on Redis. The model reached a macro-F1 of 0.88 compared with 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and it reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes. That project required careful data handling, attention to detail, and building something that was dependable in production.

Your role stands out to me because it combines the kind of hands-on data work I enjoy with a domain I’d be genuinely motivated to work in. I understand the importance of clean, consistent data and clear presentation, especially when the outputs are used directly by elite players and coaches. I’m comfortable working closely with other analysts and engineers, and I value best practices, maintainable code, and a practical approach to delivering useful results.

I’d be glad to help with collecting and transforming raw data, improving data quality, building visuals and tables in a consistent format, and supporting deeper analytical work for your clients. I also work well in remote environments and can adapt to flexible schedules across time zones.

What data sources and dashboard tools are you currently using for your tennis analytics workflows?
